meta.source: Our World in Data, Energy dataset
meta.base: Energy Institute and Ember, via OWID
meta.coverage: China: every column of OWID's energy dataset with a value, 1900 to 2025, annual. 124 series.
meta.note: Values as published by OWID (licence CC BY 4.0). Producers per column are named in OWID's codebook: Population based on various sources (2024); Bolt and van Zanden – Maddison Project Database 2023; Energy Institute - Statistical Review of World Energy (2025); Energy Institute - Statistical Review of World Energy (2025); Population based on various sources (2024); Ember - Yearly Electricity Data Europe (2026); Ember - Yearly Electricity Data (2026); Population based on various sources (2024); Ember - Yearly Electricity Data Europe (2026); Ember - Yearly Electricity Data (2026). Growth rates, per-capita figures, shares and cumulative sums are OWID's own arithmetic on those inputs.
